title: 福克斯高管：自愿降薪95%，转身游戏公司能成吗？

segments.en: What is likely to be the next huge entertainment business where I could really get in in the ground floor and and do something entrepreneurial while Running an entertainment business. I thought must be the video game business
segments.zh: 下一个大型娱乐业务可能是什么？我可以真正从底层进入，在经营娱乐业务的同时做一些创业的事情。我认为一定是视频游戏业务。

segments.en: I left Fox voluntarily which no one ever does to move to Silicon Valley Take a 95% pay cut and become the pre-revenue CEO of a little tiny video game company called Crystal Dynamics in 1993
segments.zh: 我自愿离开福克斯——没人会这么做——搬到硅谷，减薪95%，成为一家名为Crystal Dynamics的小型视频游戏公司的无收入CEO，那是1993年。

segments.en: Take two interactive I had some problems needless to say and their stock was way down and there are lots of management changes
segments.zh: Take-Two Interactive，不用说，遇到了一些问题，股价大幅下跌，管理层变动频繁。

segments.en: We're going on they came to you and asked you to come in as the chairman and did you have any hesitation about doing that?
segments.zh: 他们来找你，邀请你担任董事长，你对此有任何犹豫吗？

segments.en: Well, they didn't actually ask me it was a public company It had any number of issues It was under investigation by four government entities
segments.zh: 嗯，他们实际上没有问我。这是一家上市公司，有诸多问题，正受到四个政府实体的调查。

segments.en: It was losing a lot of money. It had a small cash balance It was likely to be bankrupt in short order had and filed financial statements that had fired its auditors
segments.zh: 它亏损严重，现金余额很少，可能很快面临债务压力，已提交财务报表，并解雇了审计师。
